text: Stormpike Quartermaster is a dwarf found in Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley.
Stormpike Herald is a human found inside Alterac Valley. He gives info about the strategy of Alterac Valley to Alliance players.
Stormshield Sentinel is a night elf located in Stormshield. The sentries can also be found around Stormshield Stronghold on Ashran. They have Sentinel Owls as pets.

Stormrider Telmin is a Wildhammer dwarf located next to an Alliance tent on the Howling Isles in Stormsong Valley. He can be seen calling a Slumbering Tempest. Next to him is also Stormflash and a bit far away is Sparkbeak.
Strafing Run is a Fire mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Warmth of the Phoenix trait.
Strangulate is a death knight PvP talent, available at level 30.
Straton was a member of Blizzard Entertainment's Web & Mobile Team. Straton posted in the Website and Mobile Feedback forums. He left Blizzard for another company in May 2013.
Strange Thing is a human located in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.
Stuart Fleming is a human fishing and fish vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He can be found about halfway up the northern dock.

Strumner Flintheel is a dwarf armor vendor found at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. Strumner was killed during the Iron Horde attack. He was killed or his body desecrated after death by his own sword being stabbed into his back.

Private Strov was a young veteran soldier of the Third War. He was considered the best soldier in Theramore by Colonel Lorena and was her most trusted warrior. Strov was one of the survivors of the war and served the Alliance through the Theramore Guard. He was known to be non descriptive, having average height and average build which made him a very good tracker. His sharp wits and keen eyesight made him especially invaluable and it saved his detail from an ambush by the Burning Blade. Strov accompanied Lorena to Northwatch Hold and brought captain Avinal to Lorena. As they were returning, the group of soldiers was attacked by orcish members of the Burning Blade clan. He and Clai survived a
Stu Whitetusk is an orc stable master located outside the Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Sulan Dunadaire is a human warlock in the House of Edune in Ashenvale. Here she lives along with her brother, William and the night elf Edune familiy.
Subversion is a death knight talent located on tier 1 of the Blood tree.
Sullah is a human found in Uldum whom adventurers will assist in the zone against Deathwing's forces. He is Harrison Jones' old friend.

Sully Kneecapper is a Wildhammer dwarf champion of the Wildhammer clan and participates in one of the matches at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands. He is an exclusive enemy for the Horde, his counterpart for the Alliance is Torg Drakeflayer.
Stymie is a human vendor located at the Valley of Heroes in Elwynn Forest. He is an orphan supervised by Orphan Matron Seacole.
Summon Water Elemental is a Frost mage talent that summons a Water Elemental minion.

Summon Gargoyle is an Unholy death knight talent that summons an Ebon Gargoyle. The gargoyle repeatedly attacks the death knight's target with Gargoyle Strike, a spell that deals Plague damage. This spell can be replaced with Dark Arbiter by speaking to Lady Alistra in Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Dark Arbiter instead summons a Val'kyr Battlemaiden who uses Val'kyr Strike, dealing damage. The spell can be changed back by speaking to Alistra again.
Summoner Mazek is a human located at the Greyfang Enclave in Dalaran.
Summoner Djobi was a man'ari eredar located in Val'sharah who corrupted the local furbolgs. He would be taken down when the Knights of the Silver Hand came to fight him.
Summoner Laniella is a human located on the expedition isles.
Summoned Skeleton is a skeletal warrior summoned by Antique Cornerstone Grimoire, Antediluvian Cornerstone Grimoire, Ancient Cornerstone Grimoire, and Book of the Dead.
Supply Officer Mills is a human food vendor located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
Supply Officer Isabel is a Forsaken general goods, meat and drink vendor located at Reaver's Fall in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Sunwalker Helaku is a tauren paladin trainer and member of the Sunwalkers located at Camp Narache in Mulgore.
Sunwalker Chagon is a tauren commander of the Kor'kron during the Lion's Landing scenario.
Supplymaster Eri is an orc with the Frostwolf Orcs that helps supply the hero's garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
Supplier Qiao is a pandaren general goods vendor located at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.
Supplier Kilbride is a draenei general goods merchant located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Supplier Barleyfoot is a dwarf found in the Skyfire Triage Camp and Lorna's Watch in Stormheim.
Sunwell Defender is a blood elf located on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Sven is a dwarf who accompanied Aegwynn in Dustwallow Marsh. He and his mistress helped Valeera Sanguinar after her battle with an assassin, who meant to kill Lo'Gosh. Sven didn't want to help Valeera because of her race, but Aegwynn told him that today's enemies could be tomorrow's friends. Thus, they aided Valeera and took her to Theramore where Aegwynn told him to find Helaina and help the blood elf and her wyvern Bristlefur. He later battled against the Scourge and got injured. After the battle, Aegwynn found him and wanted to heal his friend, but he refused telling her that he will wait for healers. It is unknown whether he survived his injuries or the destruction of Theramore.

Surena Caledon is a human found at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest. She was once an apprentice of Gakin the Darkbinder, who gifted her a bloodstone choker. She betrayed Gakin by joining Erlan Drudgemoor and the Defias Brotherhood.
Susana Averoy is a human trade goods vendor found in Glorious Goods in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was on the upper level of the shop kneeling next to "Red" Jack Findle.
Suzannah Thomson is a human of Lordaeron and the wife of Thomas Thomson, with whom she had two children, Joel and Gina.
Surveyor Daltry is a human located at Lunarfall and Frostwall. He replaces Harrison Jones in the Garrison Town Hall after the completion of Master Relic Hunter.
Susie Sizzlesong is a blood elf located in Karazhan. She is one of the Medivas and organized a party with her band members.

Suspicious Refugee is a human located in a cellar at Arom's Stand in Drustvar. She is disguised, and her true identity is Sister Littlefield. She is accompanied by two Arom's Stand Commoners who will turn into Splintered Thralls once the fight has begun.
Suspicious Infiltrator is a deceased human of the Ravenholdt located in the Twilight Highlands. The body was very badly burned and nearly bitten in half.
Susanna Barnes is a human located by the road between Fort Daelin and Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Suspcious Onlooker is a human stealthing around northern Dalaran. After being revealed by Fiona and answering questions, he runs to Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry and dissappears.
Surigosa is a blue dragon located at the Ruins of Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh, Thaldraszus, and the Azure Span.

Swamplord Musel'ek is a Broken hunter, ruler of the Murkblood, and the third boss of the Underbog in Coilfang Reservoir. He is accompanied by his pet, Claw, who is part of the quest Lost in Action which can be obtained from Watcher Jhang in front of the entrance to the dungeon. However his location in the dungeon brings into question why he is here surrounded by beasts instead of with his fellow Murkblood. This may suggest that he is in exile and hiding in the untamed parts of the Underbog.

Swing is an action (character animation) that occurs when your weapon deals damage (unless the target dodges). On-swing attacks wait for your next swing to happen (Raptor Strike (old), Heroic Strike, Maul.) They are opposed to instant attacks. The amount of time between two swings of a single weapon is equal to your attack speed. Parrying reduce the time until your next swing.
Sweet Gary Guns is a human member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. He is found aboard the The Riptide and The Crimson Veil in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is the gun vendor for the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
Swellthrasher is a Mag'har orc located in Anyport in Drustvar. She provides a way back to Zuldazar.
Syurana is a night elf trade goods vendor located in Starfall Village in Winterspring.
Sylvia is a survivor of the Blackrock orc attack on Strahnbrad who thanks Prince Arthas for saving the town.

Sya Zhong is a pandaren resident of Firebough Nook; she was one of the few villagers to survive to the attack of the sha-possessed yaungol, along with Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough and Old Lady Fung. She was found inside a house by an adventurer, who then rescued the other three villagers and led them to safety to Shado-Pan Fallback.
Syleath Fairglade is a night elf general goods vendor located at Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. He was present at the grove when the Horde invaded it during the War of the Thorns.
Syverandin Yewshade is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Sylalleas Frostwind is a Darkfallen death knight located at the Lunarfall in .
Sylvie Fallensong is a Darkfallen death knight follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Syndrella is a blood elf located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.
Sylvia Hartshorn is a night elf located at Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Sythorne is a night elf ghost located in Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna.

Sylvan Vale is a quiet vale with a small night elf settlement in Val'sharah. The vale is accessed near the beginning of the Emerald Ascent via the path leading west. It is a quiet region, although the peace is disrupted on occasion by Bloodspike Needlers.
Sylvester Chase is a human located in the Department of Mariner's Vessels in Boralus.
Sylareon Silverblade is a blood elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
High Priestess Syrebriel Tholaron is a character mentioned on the Worn Sinstone found in Revendreth.
Szarostrasza is a red dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores. She is surrounded by several Ruby Pupils and Ruby Dozers.
Sylvia Whisperbloom is a night elf located in the Wildling Garden in the Emerald Dream.
Tagar Spinebreaker is the leader of the cannibalistic Bonechewer clan.

Tai'jin is a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Razor Hill Barracks in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of Escalation, she was caged by Kor'krons but soon released by the Darkspear Rebellion. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, she was located in the burrow, standing next to an Overlord's Guard. Occasionally, she can be seen eating a haunch of meat and drinking.
Tagradin is a dwarven pilot. He is a companion of Stefon the Loyal, Guzul'dar, and Lenaeas.
High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher is the leader of the Reliquary, the Horde counterpart of the Explorers' League.

Tabelius was an elf that was training to become a demon hunter. While he survived the first part of the ritual, he was driven mad and sliced throats of several of his fellow trainees as they slept. His rampage was ultimately stopped by Needle, who put a skewer through each of his empty eye sockets.
Tactical Advance is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Crushing Blows and Precise Strikes traits.
Tad is a murloc hunter featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Tad is a murloc fisherman who simply fishes underground.
Tagart is a human located in the Roughneck Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Taddie Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Tad Deepforge is a dwarf located at the Alliance encampment at the outskirts of the Ruins of Lordaeron during Battle for Lordaeron.
Taga Stoneaxe is a dwarf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Taeredormu is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.
Tadhg Stonefoot is a dwarf located in Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Talaelar is a night elf fish vendor located in the Temple Gardens in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Tal'Kierthan (aka Ta'kierthan) was a legendary night elven priest who lived centuries ago. He employed special songs in the construction of his Tal'Kierthan Songblades. These caused the blades to chant in Darnassian during battle.
Takubvik is a tuskarr general goods vendor located in the Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight.
Tak'theritrix was a demon commander during the War of the Ancients. He was key in peeling apart the initial night elf defense.
Talah Blightspewer is an orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Talanath Goldcrest is a blood elf located on the Defiant Dragonscale in Durotar.
Talcorvius is a green dragon in a blood elf visage located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Tamar is an orc leatherworking vendor located in the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen sitting with Handor in the middle of the building.

Talgath was a high ranking leader of the Burning Legion, close to Kil'jaeden in rank. Talgath's role was to help Kil'jaeden corrupt the native populaces of different worlds. He brought down countless civilizations, and he knew how to tempt mortal hearts. Sometimes he found heroic champions who could be turned, but very often he found willing minds among those who live on a world's fringes. Talgath was an opponent the Army of the Light encountered on numerous occasions.

Talren Highbeacon is a human paladin of the Argent Crusade. Argus Highbeacon is his father. Talren is found patrolling the Eastern Plaguelands from tower to tower, lighting up the beacons on top of them. He accompanied Argus, Fiona and her caravan into on . While there, he was trapped by the botani but soon rescued by an Alliance adventurer. Talren joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. Talren joined Fiona once again and was seen at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.

Talithar Swiftwind was a blood elf mage in the service of the Horde. Following the Third War, Talithar and his wife, Vyrin Swiftwind, became estranged: Talithar opted to heed the teachings of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider in the name of his people's well-being, while Vyrin chose to retain her integrity. Their wedding rings remained in Talithar's possession, who never stopped loving his wife despite their parting; Vyrin, in turn, retained a longing for her husband, though also anger at what he had chosen to do. Talithar went on to serve the Horde in Northrend, eventually coming to staff the warship Warchief's Fist. There, he met Chen Stormstout, though the two did not get off to the best start.
Tamaro is an orc located in the Mighty Pen shop in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's located upstairs, talking to Sarlek.
Tamara Armstrong was a human located at Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of the town by Forsaken plague bombing, Tamara's fate is unclear.
Tamara Bakhlycheva is a Blizzard employee and member of the World of Warcraft art team. Bakhlycheva is a 3D character artist and has worked in the game industry since 2005.
Taloren Whitedawn is a blood elf priest located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.
Talon Bond is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Jaws of the Mongoose and Echoes of Ohn'ara traits.
Tallis Skyheart is a human located at Greystone Relief in Tiragarde Sound. He was the commanding officer of Greystone Keep, before the mutiny led by Fernn the Turncoat.
Tamara Barrie is a human located in Tiragarde Sound. She is part of Taelia Fordragon's patrol squad.
Talismonger Rentala is a night elf ghost located at the Drowned Market in Nazjatar.

Talis is a bakar spirit sitting next to Rivan in the ruined structure in the center of the Sylvan Glade in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Both she and Rivan are normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening. Gifting Talis two Braised Bruffalon Brisket is required for Honor Our Ancestors.
Talisa Whisperbloom is a night elf located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
Talthis is a blood elf paladin located in Brackenhide Hollow in the Azure Span and in Thaldraszus.

Tandred Proudmoore is a captain of the Kul Tiran fleet, son of the former Lord Admiral Daelin and Katherine Proudmoore, and the youngest brother of Derek and Jaina. He is described as a fearless explorer and sailor of uncharted waters.

Tannok Frosthammer is a dwarf located at Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Tannok is concerned with the lack of communication with Anvilmar due to the trogg infestation of Coldridge Pass. He deals with Hands Springsprocket, a supplier from Coldridge Valley. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Tamra Stormpike is a rare undead dwarf found in the inner level of Dun Garok in Hillsbrad Foothills. She is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.
Tanathal is a lich being interrogated by the death knight Thassarian in the Wailing Ziggurat in the Borean Tundra.

Tarkreu Shadowstalker is an orc located at Ironstone Camp in Thousand Needles. He seems to be a member of the orcish war party led by Moktar Krin. The following orcs are supposedly also members of said war party: *Nag'zehn *Bor'zehn *War Party Kodo While his companions can be found fighting off the Grimtotem near Freewind Post following the Cataclysm, Tarkreu is nowhere to be found. He may have been slain in the flooding of Thousand Needles, or by the Grimtotem.

Tarakor was a member of the Grimtotem tribe and was the second in command of the Grimtotem squadron who were ordered to assassinate Baine Bloodhoof while he resided in Bloodhoof Village. When the commander of the squadron Jevan Grimtotem, known as Stormsong, told him to wait while he investigated to make sure that Baine was unaware of his father's death Tarakor did so. However when the wait proved to last too long he ordered his warriors to start attacking Bloodhoof Village. He was not surprised to discover that the citizens of the village were prepared, having assumed that Stormsong had been captured. After killing many of the village defenders and noticing that Baine was nowhere to be seen
Tarmod is a hunter trainer at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town alongside his pet Koru.
Tarm Deepgale is a Wildhammer dwarf stable master located at Thundermar in the Twilight Highlands.
Taoshi is a high-ranking member of the Shado-Pan. She is described by their leader Taran Zhu as "my best", and is often seen in the position of Taran's right-hand man.
Tan'shang is the raptor Ohgan'aka meets as she tries to escape Zul'Gurub.

Tannos was a mage sent by Theocritus to Westfall with the Hand of Azora in order to hide him from the sight of the Dark Riders who were searching after artifacts. When Karlain and Revil Kost found him, Tannos was helping Westfall's militia against the Defias Brotherhood at Gold Coast Quarry. After the Brotherhood was defeated, the Dark Riders appeared and cut Tannos's head and hand off, taking the Hand of Azora with them.
Tarlo Mondan is a human war veteran who fought many battles.
Tarn Redfist is an orc banker found in Warspear Hold in Warspear on Ashran.

Tao-Long is a member of the Shado-Pan. While transporting a missive to be delivered to Haohan Mudclaw, the young pandaren Ten thinking the Shado-Pan merchants stole the missive on accident. The Shado-Pan quickly realized that the missive had been stolen and gave chance when a panicked Ten ran around. Upon capturing Ten, it was revealed that Tao-Long thought Ten was a spy meant to intercept the missive and deliver to the mantid. Ten, however, was able to get away from the Shado-Pan which inspired Master Nurong to invite them to join the Shado-Pan order, while Tao-Long presumably went back to his duties.
Tar Trap is a row 4 hunter talent. It tosses a trap on the ground that, when triggered, creates an area of snaring tar.
Tara Swiftblade is a Kul Tiran human located in the Siege of Boralus.
Tarley Fellhew is a dwarf located at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores. He can be seen briefing the occasional Expedition Scout landing their gyrocopters next to him.

Tarshaw Jaggedscar is an orc warrior trainer located in the Razor Hill Barracks in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of Escalation, he was caged by Kor'krons but soon released by the Darkspear Rebellion. He claimed that Garrosh Hellscream was no longer his Warchief because he shed young warriors' lives recklessly. Tarshaw also explained that Garrosh's goons didn't like that he kept working with trolls. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by Alliance forces that tried to salvage the Scuttle Coast and Tiragarde Keep. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he was practicing on a training dummy. He appears at the Kosh'harg standing next to Runda and Burok.
Tarrel Rockweaver is a dwarf located on the Menethil Harbor bridge in the Wetlands. His wife, Merrin Rockweaver was part of Whelgar's Excavation team which is now located at Whelgar's Retreat.
Tatiana is a human master jewelcrafting trainer and vendor located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Tattooed Marcy is a human located Scalawag Point in the Howling Fjord.

Tawn Winterbluff is a tauren member of the Earthen Ring located in Deepholm and the Twilight Highlands. She later arrives at the Maw of Destruction to help escort Thrall to Wyrmrest Temple, but is killed by the Old Gods' minions.

Taryssa Lazuria is a blood elf vendor found in Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She sells jewelcrafting recipes at the cost of Illustrious Jewelcrafter's Token, which are awarded after completing daily quests from Marith Lazuria.

Tas'ira was a night elf Watcher. She alongside Neva attacked and almost killed worgen Eadrik. They thought he was dead, but moments later, he killed Tas'ira and attacked and mortally wounded Neva in order to rescue Jarod's life.
Tathan Thunderstone is a Wildhammer dwarf stable master located at the Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.
Tarquinn is a night elf trade goods vendor located at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

Tarys was a proto-dragon of blue-white coloration and an old friend of Malygos. When the two of them were young, Tarys and Malygos would often hunt and learn together. Alexstrasza and Ysera would later discover the corpse of Tarys and another proto-dragon, along with a living but terrified purple proto-dragon, and alerted Malygos. One of the corpses, which may or may not have been Tarys, came to life and attacked before Malygos tore off its head. The other one was torn apart by Alexstrasza and Ysera before it, too, became undead.
Taskmaster Gurran is an orc lieutenant of in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Tasha Highfoot is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, she appears in Stormwind Harbor, working at the forge with Gussof Forgefire.
Tavid Blightsteel is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Taskmaster Banegore is an orc located at the Writhing Mire in Spires of Arak.
Tas'ril Imturematril is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Taskmaster Kullah is an orc located at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
Taylor Liptz is a human located at Hatherford in Tiragarde Sound.
Taskmaster Emday is a human located at the Proudmoore Keep in Boralus. He can be found at the center of the hedge maze, looking for a few cadets.
Taskmaster Williams is a human located at the Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Taruka Flamehand is a Mag'har orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Tederastrasz is a red dragon located at the Vermillion Redoubt in Twilight Highlands.

Teegli Merrowith is a Dark Iron dwarf mage trainer located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh. She is one of the few Alliance Dark Iron dwarves that followed Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the other clans.
Tednug is an orc that walks along the road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar with his feline companion, Scratchfever.

Tearlach was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was one of the Wildhammers who fell during the second raid on the orcs in the Hinterlands when they started throwing spears. His death was reported to Kurdran by Iomhar.
Ted is a human character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Team Leader Scooter is a human located in the Assault on Zan'vess.

Tel'kor was a young high elf ranger who served under Sylvanas Windrunner's command during the Third War. He was sent to the Sunwell Plateau, to tell the magi what they saw at the first struggle with the Scourge and to be prepared.
Teloch is a pygmy witch doctor of Oostan Ost village located on Lost Isles.
Teller Gee is a human banker located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran. When Dalaran moved above Karazhan, he assured several Dalaran Citizens about the well being of their money.
Teller Plushner is a human banker located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran. When Dalaran moved above Karazhan, he was collecting gold that was all around the bank.
Tell'machrim Stormvigil is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Telys Vinemender is a night elf found inside the Stormshield Barracks in Stormshield.

Telmek was an orc captured by the Warmaul ogres and brought aboard their vessel. He and a dozen of orcs was convinced by a fellow slave to escape. Telmek found a length of chain which he wanted to use to kill the ogres. However, the attempt was unsuccessful.
Tempest Artillery Loader is an orc located in the Tempest's Roar above Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Tempered Flames is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Improved Combustion.

Terenthis was a night elf druid located in Auberdine in Darkshore. He had come to Darkshore to investigate the spread of Fel Moss's effects, and he hoped to put a stop to it. While there, he was sought out by the bear Grimclaw, whose master had been attacked by furbolgs. Terenthis sent adventurers to help. During the Cataclysm, he tried to flee from Auberdine's destruction but died on the beach.
Tenell Leafrunner is a night elf located at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.

Tenjiyu is the second raptor that Ohgan'aka meets as she tries to escape Zul'Gurub. Tenjiyu always let her to pass, but ask that she steal some food from trolls because the raptor hasn't been feed in days.
Teraptor Matriarch is a large raptor and leader of the local raptors on the Lost Isles.
Terndak is an orc weapon vendor located at Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Ten is a young pandaren member of the Shado-Pan. His name, Ten, literally represents the number ten, as his father ran out of interesting names after the fifth son.

Teron'gor was an orc warlock, leader of the Gorebound, he was a servant of and a member of the . He was charged with infiltrating the draenei mausoleum of , where he was defeated by a group of adventurers and fell into the depths of the complex. After consuming hundreds of draenei souls, Teron'gor transformed into a bloated abomination known as Gorefiend and was transported to , where he was once again defeated.
Temura Ence is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Teris Blightsunder is a blood elf located in the Sunsworn Camp in Talador. He came to with the Sunsworn. He has blue eyes.
Tenderizer was a Protection warrior honor talent, available at rank 22.
Tenno Thornpaw is a night elf is a wounded druid in Bear Form located in Val'sharah. Their wounds is tended to by Rylissa Bearsong.

Tempra is a bronze dragon in dwarf form who serves as the Warlords of Draenor Timewalking vendor for Alliance players. She can be found just outside the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield during the Warlords version of the event. Her Horde equivalent is Kronnus.
Terl Arakor is a human standing next to a wagon on the road through Sundown Marsh in the Wetlands. His dialogue provides hints on how to find some of the rare mobs of the Wetlands.
Temporal Investigator Tempo is a bronze dragon located just outside Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus. she is accompanied by a group of Temporal Defenders and Temporal Investigators.

Thadius Grimshade is a Wildhammer dwarf found in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. He was described as a wildhammer diviner who left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge. It's unknown if he survived the Ironmarch.
Terry Palin is a human lumberjack and wood vendor located in Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the lumber mill in the north-western part of the camp.

Thaddeus Loenbrough is an orc considered to be an esteemed photographer as well as the founder of the Royal Photographic Society of Azeroth. He is apparently affiliated with the Alliance as the society is apparently given royal decrees for the glory of the King as opposed to the Warchief of the Horde.

Dread Commander Thalanor is a high-ranking member of the Knights of the Ebon Blade situated in Acherus: The Ebon Hold. He was once a Farstrider who died to Arthas Menethil and the Scourge during the invasion of Quel'Thalas, dying right outside Deatholme early into the invasion. He first appeared as Scourge Commander Thalanor and ordered death knights to descend to the Scarlet Enclave to wreak destruction. He sells Winged Steed of the Ebon Blade to death knight players for . Thalanor visited Dalaran to bring the Deathlord back to the Ebon Hold above the Broken Isles. He is later seen in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Thalorien Dawnseeker was a high elf who gained fame for wielding the blade Quel'Delar. With the sword, he was part of the defense unit that guarded the Sunwell during the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas until he fell in battle against the death knight Morlen Coldgrip. His corpse remains where he fell, on the southern tip of the Dead Scar on the Isle of Quel'Danas. He was a friend of Lana'thel, who took up Quel'Delar after his death and carried it to Northrend in the service of Prince Kael'thas.

Queen Tess Greymane is a member of the Royal Family of Gilneas, the daughter of King Genn Greymane. Following to her brother's death, Tess became heir to the throne of the kingdom of Gilneas. With Liam gone, Tess is searching for answers to questions she never thought she would ask. After the successful reclamation of their kingdom, Genn bestowed the throne to Tess, officially becoming the Queen of Gilneas.
Tessa Glennon was a human who worked as stable master in the Stables of Lunarfall.
Tessa Gadson is a human located at the Lunarfall's Herb Garden in .
Tessa Wybroff is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Thaal'kos Thundersong is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Thal'xur is a fel lord that appeared in various locations during the Legion Invasions. He also appears in Val'sharah during Legion Assaults.
Terry Rigglesmith is a human located in the Norwington Inn in Tiragarde Sound.
Terrance Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Tess Tomalin is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Thaalean is a night elf located with three Sleeping Druids in a cave in the Slumbersome Shores in the Emerald Dream.
Thaelishar Groveheart is a night elf located in the Wildling Garden in the Emerald Dream.

Thanthaldis Snowgleam is a night elf PvP rewards vendor located outside the Alterac Valley entrance in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He is the Stormpike Supply Officer for the Alliance. He was present during the Legion Invasions. During Warcraft's Anniversary he became time-displaced and his stock would scale up to max level.

Thamner Pol is a dwarf first aid trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Ironically, during the Legion invasions, he became injured and was thus unable to help his fellow dwarves, something that he complained a lot about.
Tharynn Bouden is a human trade goods vendor located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He can be found beside a wagon at the start of the south-eastern road out of Goldshire.

Thamarian is a night elf located on the Auberdine docks in Darkshore. He gives directions to the different boats that provide passage from Auberdine to other locations in the world. After Auberdine's destruction during the Cataclysm, he is nowhere to be found and isn't mentioned in any quests.
Tharlidun is an orc stable master located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Thauris Balgarr is a rare dark dwarf found in the Burning Steppes. He is armed with a rifle as well as Dark Iron Land Mines.

Thargas Anvilmar is an Ironforge dwarf in service of king Magni Bronzebeard who has fought alongside King Varian. He is currently the patriarch of the Anvilmars and last direct descendant of Modimus Anvilmar, the last High King of all dwarves.

Thathrell is a tothrezim sorcerer, warlock, and warmage. He is the group leader of tothrezim debt collectors used for particularly dangerous debt collections. His group is one of four specialized collection teams. Under his command are Kurzill, Dweezel, Mazgrek, and five adamantine stalkers.

Thassarian is the first death knight to join the Alliance. As a young man, he joined the Lordaeron army hoping to follow in his father's footsteps. Thassarian followed Prince Arthas on his expedition to Northrend, where he was slain and reanimated by the Scourge. He was forced to kill his own mother to prove his loyalty and took part in the scourging of Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas. One of the few death knights of Acherus who maintained a genuine sense of honor and brotherhood, Thassarian developed a strong bond with the elf Koltira Deathweaver despite being enemies in life, considering themselves brothers in death. During the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel, he was freed from the Lich King's co
Thargen Heavyquill is a dwarf inscription vendor located inside the Thistlefuzz Arcanery shop in the eastern side of the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Thaumaturge Saresse is a blood elf commander of the Kor'kron during the Lion's Landing scenario.

Thar'zul is a fel lord of the Burning Legion who leads the Legion invasion of Karazhan. He claims to have been sent by "the Great One" (likely Sargeras) and that Medivh opened the way for the Legion's victory. He later appeared at the Master's Cellar in Deadwind Pass.
Thanid Glowergold is a dwarf located at Legendary Leathers in Dalaran.
Than Starlance is a night elf ghost located in the Ruins of Nar'thalas of Azsuna. He was found by his children 10 000 years after his death with the help of a class order leader.

Thargil is a member of the Horde and one of the three spies sent to gather information on Theramore and the Alliance. Marg Nighteye would send him and his companion Uleg to gain information on a vessel that just landed, the Bleeding Sparrow, in hopes of gaining some political documents. They would succeed at finding the information that they were looking for but dropped it in the sea when they ended up getting caught. Thargil was ultimately captured by the Theramore Guard while Uleg escaped. It is unknown what happened to him afterwards. He could have been executed, or died during the bombing of Theramore.
Thanessa Silverbloom is a blood elf located in Three-Falls Lookout in Azure Span.
Theocritus is a human mage located in the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. He is the owner of the tower and can be found on the top floor.
Theodrus Frostbeard is a dwarf priest trainer located at the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.
Theldren is an elite dwarf who hangs out at the arena Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. He is part of several gladiators which he participates along with in the arena.
Theine Brightsong is a high elf located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
Theremis is a blood elf on the draenei ship moored to the dock of the Sun's Reach Harbor of the Isle of Quel'Danas. He sells Tier 6 armor for all classes.

Therazane's Throne is a large area and throne for the earth lord Therazane found in northern Deepholm on the upper shelf. The throne is filled with the most polished and reflective crystals in all of Deepholm, to which they continue to collect in exchange for gold they often pay to those able to collect. After Therazane met the Stone Lords and the new Farseer of the Earthen Ring, Aeosara with her eggs moved here as they were attacked by Felrock troggs.
Thelonius is a pandaren monk and a follower of Chi-Ji at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in Krasarang Wilds.
Theoden Manners is a human inscription trainer and vendor located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Theo'drosh Blindseyed is an orc located at the Axefall‎ in Spires of Arak. He can be recruited as a follower. During the Faction Assaults, he appears at Gale's Rest in Stormsong Valley.
Theoric was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Thelsia Oakthorn is a dwarf paladin of the Silver Hand located in Stratholme. She can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows.
Theodor Forestwatcher is a human located in Snowmelt Foothills in Drustvar.
Theresa Norman is a human located at Old Drust Road north of Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.

Thoras Trollbane was the human warrior king of the kingdom of Stromgarde, and a founding member of the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. Years later he withdrew from the Alliance due to disagreements with his friend King Terenas Menethil II. Thoras was ultimately murdered by his son, Galen, who sought the throne of Stromgarde for himself. Buried in his family tomb at Stromgarde, he was resurrected by the Deathlord of the Knights of the Ebon Blade during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, on the orders of the Lich King Bolvar Fordragon, in order to join the ranks of the new Four Horsemen and protect Azeroth once more.
Thonys Pillarstone is a dwarf located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Thief Catcher Shadowdelve is a dwarf found patrolling the halls of Ironforge.
Thief Catcher Thunderbrew is a dwarf found patrolling the halls of Ironforge.
Thom Denger is a Forsaken mage trainer at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Thordun Hammerblow is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon rider located in the Twilight Highlands.
Thomas Booker is a human located at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. He is helping the town by filling up sand bags. Occasionally he tosses dirt at Tarrel Rockweaver.
Thomas Pieracci is a human dockhand located at the Lunarfall Shipyard. He can be found drunk and passed out on the pier, surrounded by several bottles.
Tho'gar Gorefist is an orc located at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
Thol'drel is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Foreman Thomas Staughton is a human located at Carver's Harbor in Drustvar. Griffith Shelvey had recently delivered a shipment of meat to him.
Thorgen Grimwatt is a dwarf located in Grimwatt's Crash in Nazmir.
Thirsting Blades is an Azerite trait available to Havoc demon hunters.

Thottbot was an addon which automatically saved data from the game — like monster drops, weapon stats, monster spawn locations, and character profile data. The collected data was later uploaded to the website of the same name, [http://www.thottbot.com/ Thottbot.com], either automatically or manually. The uploaded data available on the site was used for many applications such as finding NPCs that you need to complete a certain quest, items that you might have to retrieve, or even the drop rate of items from different monsters. Thotar is an orc hunter trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he was standing outside next to Kaplak and his wolf, Dirt.
Thran Khorman is a dwarf warrior trainer located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh.
Thrawn Boltar is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Thragomm is an elite orc encountered on the eastern side of the Loch in Loch Modan. Thragomm's fellow Horde Runners were Gradok and Haren Swifthoof. They were the equivalent of the Alliance Outrunners in the Barrens.
Thralosh is an orc cloth and leather armor vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Thorkaf Dragoneye is an orc artisan dragonscale leatherworking trainer located in a small camp south of the Dustwind Gulch in the Badlands. He has been missing since the Cataclysm.
Thorvald Deepforge is a dwarf found in Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

Thrall's Thrashers is a 10 man raid group formed near the entrance into the Molten Fields of Firelands within the Molten Front zone. They can be seen waiting around on the AFK member of their raid Johnny Awesome while growing impatient. There is a fish feast, a mage table, and even a cauldron down nearby.
Thrakgar is a Horde orc shaman with a chance to appear in the Trial of the Crusader against the Alliance.
Thorn Sutton is a human located at the Crimson Coast in Drustvar. He is a part of the Crimson Cutthroats, a notorious band of outlaws.

Thornspeaker Birchgrove is a Kul Tiran druid and a member of the Thornspeakers located at Gol Koval in Drustvar. He is apparently friends with the legendary shipwright Dorian Atwater. When it comes to druidic matters, Dorian trusts no one else.

Thrall's Armor is the general name covering all of the Horde Shaman Tier 9 Sets. The Thrall's Garb set is focused on the Restoration tree, the Thrall's Battlegear set is focused on the Enhancement (Melee DPS) tree, and the Thrall's Regalia set is focused on the Elemental (Ranged DPS) tree. Thule Ravenclaw was a young mage with great promise in the years before the Third War.

Throk'Feroth was an orc far seer of the Blackrock clan and commander of the Blackrock Raiders who defended the demon gate which the lich Kel'Thuzad used to commune with the demon lord Archimonde. Arthas and Kel'Thuzad killed him along with four other orcs guarding the demon gate.
Thund is an orc located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. He appears dead in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Thultash is an orc meat and drink vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Thultazor is an orc reagent vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Thulrin is a dwarf located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Thug Shirt is the starting shirt for orc, troll, and undead rogues.
Threm Blackscalp is an orc leatherworker vendor for the Dragonmaw Clan. He is located at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Thressa Amberglen is a night elf located at Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace.
Thug Vest is the starting chest for orc, undead, and troll rogues.
Thuldren is a Dark Iron dwarf located at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Thronebreaker is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Runic Chills trait.
Thunder Crash is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Dragon Skin, Intolerance, and Reflective Plating traits.

Throk is an orc located in the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. He also appears at Ar'gorok in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He trains Horde Grunts, Horde Axe Throwers, Horde Shaman, and Horde Raiders for iron (Warfronts).
Thurgrum Deepforge is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
